title: Not even compatible with its web version
body: I have a list of takss has multiple sub tasks that I've created in Tasks' web based version but their app won't even support anything more than one sub task level. Decided not to allow the app to convert my delicately created tasks list. After further testing with the app, I find that when you mark a sub task as complete, and then unmark it, it does not restore it to the original task it was under, and there's no way to move it back to a task. It's a simple but very flawed app.
